name: focus-cards
title: Focus Cards
description: A three-by-two grid of landscape photo cards. Pointing at one keeps it sharp, darkens it with a white title, and blurs and shrinks the others.
use: A set of six to nine images should let one stand out on hover without opening a lightbox.
avoid: The effect is hover-only, so touch users see a plain grid, and it needs photos of matching shape.
a11y: The focus effect and titles are hover-only, so keyboard users cannot reveal any title, and there is no reduced-motion check. (keyboard: no, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A three-by-two grid of rounded landscape photo cards on black, each a different scene: mountains, a green valley, misty forest, desert rocks and coast. On hover the chosen card stays sharp while the rest blur and shrink slightly.
behaves: Pointing at one photo blurs and slightly shrinks the other five and darkens the chosen card with a white title at its bottom-left. Moving away restores the whole grid.
customise: Pass a cards array of title and image src and drop it into any container. The three-column breakpoint, blur amount and title styling are fixed.
weight: light: Six images with CSS blur and scale transitions; no script loop.
